title: Traversal Constructs: Ladders/Steps, Rideable Ram (extension to construct core)
description:
Purpose: Extend traversal options with Ladder/Stepping Projections and a rideable Battering Ram/Surf construct. Bridge and platform integration leverages promoted.ring_construct_core; this module adds sequencing, anchors, and a rideable vehicle profile.

Controls:
- Right Trigger: Confirm spawn of traversal construct from the Utility/Traversal category.
- B Button: Cancel ride / dismiss active traversal preview.
- Left Grip: While previewing ladders/steps, adjust spacing along the normal; two-hand rotation aligns a ladder span.

Params (params_json):
- step_spacing_m (float, default 0.35)
- step_count (int, default 5)
- ladder_max_length_m (float, default 3.0)
- ram_speed_mps (float, default 4.0)
- ram_stabilize (bool, default true) adds slight camera stabilization while riding
- ram_cancel_on_collision (bool, default true)

Behaviour:
1) Ladders/Steps:
   - Preview shows a sequenced set of construct_ladder_steps aligned to a surface normal with snap-to-grid markers. On confirm, spawns steps with proper colliders and a 30s despawn timer.
2) Rideable Ram:
   - On confirm, spawns construct_ram_surf slightly ahead. Player auto-mounts; applies forward push at ram_speed_mps with gentle horizon stabilization (if ram_stabilize). Collisions trigger an impact flare and optional auto-cancel. B cancels ride.
3) Bridges/Platforms:
   - Delegates to core for platform and bridge segment placement; auto-segmentation across gaps based on anchors from construct_platform_and_bridge_set.

Components:
- Reads: surface anchors, player transform, input grips for alignment.
- Writes: spawned construct entities with CPhysics + ride/mount tag, stabilization flags, VFX.

Comfort/safety:
- Ram ride uses camera stabilization and no roll; speeds capped; cancelable anytime with B.

Acceptance hooks:
- Satisfies test_platform_bridge_gap in asteroid_mining_outpost; ladders allow vertical traversal in derelict_space_station.

Integration:
- Registers traversal entries under promoted.ring_construct_core categories.
- Uses assets: construct_platform_and_bridge_set, construct_ladder_steps, construct_ram_surf, construct_energy_vfx_core.

Suggested file split: traversal_constructs_register.cpp, traversal_ladders.cpp, traversal_ram.cpp.
